title: FastAPI Backend Bootstrap
description: Create the HTTP application using FastAPI as the backend entry point and configure the project for API execution.
acceptance: FastAPI is installed and configured as a project dependency.
The application starts successfully using a standard ASGI server.
The API exposes a health endpoint returning HTTP 200.
The project structure separates application, domain, and infrastructure concerns.

title: Mock Market Data Resources
description: Provide realistic market data fixtures for BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT using the MarketData model schema.
acceptance: JSON resources exist for BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT.
Each JSON document conforms to analysis.models.market.MarketData.
Mock resources are stored under a dedicated resources directory.
The mock data can be loaded without code changes.

title: Market Data Provider
description: Define a MarketDataProvider port and adapter implementations that allow the application to retrieve MarketData independently of the underlying data source.
acceptance: A MarketDataProvider port defines the contract for retrieving MarketData.
A MockMarketDataProvider adapter loads MarketData objects from JSON resources.
Application and domain logic depend only on the MarketDataProvider port.
New adapters can be added or substituted without modifying application or domain code.

title: Analysis to Classification Pipeline
description: Connect the deterministic analysis module with the classification module using the existing assessment_to_classifications mapper.
acceptance: MarketData is processed by the deterministic analysis module.
Analysis assessments are transformed using assessment_to_classifications.py.
The classifier module receives only mapped DTOs.
No direct coupling exists between analysis internals and the classifier.

title: Classification REST API
description: Expose classification results through a REST API endpoint using DTOs instead of domain objects.
acceptance: The API accepts a market symbol as input.
The endpoint returns the current classification DTO.
HTTP responses use API DTOs rather than domain models.
Invalid requests return appropriate HTTP status codes.

title: Market Data API
description: Expose market data through a REST API endpoint using DTOs instead of domain objects.
acceptance: The API accepts a market symbol as input.
The endpoint returns the current market data DTO.
HTTP responses use API DTOs rather than domain models.
Invalid requests return appropriate HTTP status codes.

title: Market Data Analysis API
description: Expose market data analysis through a REST API endpoint using DTOs instead of domain objects.
acceptance: The API accepts a market symbol as input.
The endpoint returns the current market data analysis DTO.
HTTP responses use API DTOs rather than domain models.
Invalid requests return appropriate HTTP status codes.

title: Classification Reason Codes in OpenAPI
description: Declare the closed set of classification signal reason codes on HTTP response DTOs so OpenAPI exposes them as the FE source of truth for mapping codes to human-readable text.
acceptance: Classification signal reason values are typed as a closed set on HTTP response DTOs (Literal or Enum), not as unconstrained strings.
The OpenAPI schema for the classification endpoint documents the allowed reason codes as enum values.
Classifiers emit only reason codes that belong to the declared DTO contract.
The HTTP DTO remains the public contract surface; clients can derive reason codes from OpenAPI without reading domain code.

title: Analysis Regime and Reason Codes in OpenAPI
description: Declare closed sets for analysis regime labels and regime reason codes on HTTP response DTOs so OpenAPI exposes them as the FE source of truth for mapping codes to human-readable text.
acceptance: RegimeAssessmentResponse.regime is typed as a closed set on the HTTP DTO (Literal or Enum), not as an unconstrained string.
RegimeAssessmentResponse.reasons items are typed as a closed set of reason codes on the HTTP DTO (Literal or Enum), matching codes emitted by RegimeDetector.
The OpenAPI schema for the analysis endpoint documents allowed regime and reason values as enum values.
RegimeDetector emits only reason codes that belong to the declared DTO contract.
The HTTP DTO remains the public contract surface; clients can derive regime and reason codes from OpenAPI without reading domain code.

title: Analysis MessageRefs
description: Replace analysis catalog/assessment prose and token dumps with structured MessageRef (code + params) on analysis HTTP DTOs so clients consume message references instead of display English.
acceptance: User-facing analysis narrative that today is free-text prose or interpolated English is emitted as MessageRef (code + params) on the analysis HTTP response DTOs.
Catalog/assessment builders in analysis domain do not emit interpolated display English for those narrative fields.
MessageRef params carry typed data only (enums, numbers, ids) — never prose.
OpenAPI for the analysis endpoint documents the MessageRef shape (and updated fields) on the public contract.
Clients can consume MessageRefs without reading domain internals; the backend does not resolve display copy.

title: Classification MessageRefs
description: Emit MessageRefs (not display English) for classification user-facing narrative and errors as needed on classification HTTP DTOs.
acceptance: Classification signals (and related user-facing narrative fields in scope) expose MessageRef (code + params) instead of display English sentences.
Classification domain/classifiers do not emit interpolated display English for those fields.
Where in-scope API errors need client-resolvable copy, responses carry a machine code and/or MessageRef rather than hardcoded English sentences in routes.
OpenAPI for the classification endpoint documents the MessageRef shape (and updated fields) on the public contract.
Reason-code closed sets remain usable as MessageRef codes or params as designed; clients resolve text outside BE domain.
